channel.title: Benin - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Benin, every source cited.

item.title: Benin bishops announce African traditional religion conference
item.description: The conference, scheduled for November 19-20, 2026, aims to foster mutual understanding between faiths.

item.title: Benin women's handball team draws Egypt for Africa Cup
item.description: The Amazones will face Egypt, Congo, and Cape Verde in Group A of the 2026 tournament in Tunisia.

item.title: Benin Supreme Court to address electoral judge role
item.description: The court will hold its solemn judicial opening for 2026-2027 on November 5 in Porto-Novo.

item.title: Benin sextortion victims fear judgment
item.description: Women and girls make up 69% of sextortion victims in Benin, facing shame and silence.

item.title: Akpakpa Boys and Ace win cotonou beach tour
item.description: The cotonou stage of the benin beach tour concluded on october 25, 2026, with Akpakpa Boys and Ace claiming the men's and women's titles respectively.
